sources.snippet: Domia runs sherpa-onnx in-process for keyword spotting, voice activity detection, streaming and offline speech recognition, and text-to-speech. Speech engines and models are selected through per-companion configuration, making it easy to match supported sherpa-onnx models to different hardware.

sources.snippet: Note Simulated streaming speech recognition: It uses a non-streaming ASR model for real-time/streaming speech recognition. For instance, use Whisper, Moonshine, SenseVoice, nvidia/parakeet-tdt-.6b-v2, etc, for real-time speech recognition.
